summary: Iteration-4 bug-fix verification (BUG-001..017). Added /app/backend/tests/test_bugfixes_iteration4.py (19 new focused tests). Combined pytest run: 100/100 passing (44 Phase 0/1/2 + 37 Phase 3+5 + 19 iter-4). Also patched one stale assertion in backend_test.py (cross-tenant now 403 per BUG-003). UI smoke on preview URL confirms every data-testid called for in the request is present and wired: staff seeing /settings, /templates, /automations, /billing, /admin, /sales all render AccessDenied (data-testid=access-denied) WITHOUT redirect; owner Settings page has settings-slot_capacity; superadmin Admin page has health-vapi, health-elevenlabs, health-free-numbers; Garages tab exposes create-garage-form + new-garage-business/owner/email + create-garage-btn + empty-pool-warning; Number pool tab exposes buy-area-code + buy-number-btn (not clicked - would purchase a real Twilio number); Integrations tab exposes BILLING_GRACE_DAYS, SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES, DEFAULT_TRIAL_DAYS inputs; Audit log tab exposes audit-actor-filter + audit-date-from + audit-date-to and rows show actor email (role), action and path exactly as BUG-002/BUG-014 require. Backend side verified end-to-end: owner-only APIs return 403 for staff AND write an audit entry (action=access.denied, entity_id=path, actor=user_id); cross-tenant GET /contacts/{id} returns 403 while a random id returns 404; forgot-password returns a generic 200 for unknown emails and processes real signed-up users; a seeded password-reset token lets a user reset -> old password now 401, new one works, token reuse 4xx, sessions revoked; forcing last_seen_at to -2h on a signup session makes /auth/me return 401 with 'Session expired after inactivity' message (SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES default 60); /admin/overview exposes vapi/elevenlabs/free_numbers; PATCH /contacts phone round-trip + duplicate 409 + invalid-phone 4xx; two public /book calls to the same slot: first 200, second 409 'That time is no longer available' (slot_capacity default 1) and the slot disappears from /public/slots; public booking without consent produces zero outbound confirmation/reminder24/reminder2 messages for that contact; POST /messages/process now returns both results[] and service_due_queued integer (BUG-012); PATCH /vehicles updates km and the change persists; GET /admin/audits honours actor= + date_from/date_to filters; PUT /admin/settings DEFAULT_TRIAL_DAYS=21 -> next signup trial_ends is 21±2 days out; POST /sales/prospects rejects duplicate phone (409) and DNC phone (409). SMS stayed in simulated mode throughout.
critical_code_review_comments: crm.py VehicleUpdateIn requires ALL fields (make/model/year/plate/km) instead of Optional — partial PATCH payloads are rejected with 422. Test flow for BUG-013 therefore has to resend the full vehicle. Consider making fields Optional (like ContactUpdateIn does) so the edit-vehicle-dialog can send only {km:...}; current code works but the API shape is inconsistent with /contacts PATCH.

auth.py access.denied audit uses entity_id to carry the request path (and detail.path too). It works and the Audit UI renders it, but conceptually storing a path in entity_id is a bit of a semantic overload — a dedicated 'path' column (or always reading from detail.path) would be cleaner.

auth.py get_ctx: when a session passes idle expiry it is deleted (good) but the response message 'Session expired after inactivity. Please sign in again.' is a 401 with no cookie-clearing header; the frontend already handles /login?expired=1 but defensively clearing the session_token cookie on this 401 would avoid repeat round-trips with stale tokens.

public.py race guard reads slot_capacity from tenant doc both in available_slots() and after insert — correct belt-and-suspenders. The second-booking rejection message 'Sorry, that time was just booked by someone else...' is only hit when the overlap check races between slots computation and insert; the common path returns 'That time is no longer available. Choose another.' — both messages satisfy BUG-008.

messaging.py inbound YES targeting correctly picks the appointment whose latest confirmation/reminder was sent (BUG-010 logic); fallback to single-upcoming is safe; multi-upcoming without any sent reminder correctly audits appointment.reply-needs-attention instead of guessing.

backend/tests/backend_test.py line 105 had a stale assertion requiring 404 on cross-tenant /contacts/{id}; BUG-003 explicitly changes this to 403. I updated the assertion so the 81-test baseline keeps passing.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (patched one stale assertion for BUG-003: cross-tenant now 403 not 404)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke-tested selectors present (access-denied on all 6 owner-only pages, settings-slot_capacity, admin tabs + health + audit filters + create-garage-form + buy-area-code + buy-number-btn, Integrations SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES + DEFAULT_TRIAL_DAYS fields)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create ~8 ephemeral tenants prefixed TEST_bug3_, TEST_reset_, TEST_delivered_, TEST_idle_, TEST_trial_ via /auth/signup; several TEST_A/B/V customers (416-xxx-xxxx) under the demo tenant; 1 duplicate-phone and 1 DNC-phone sales prospect under +1 647-xxx-xxxx (DNC phone cleaned up by test). Two public /book rows are created on the first open weekday slot of the demo garage within ~2 weeks (consent-on + consent-off). Rate_limits collection may need manual flush between runs; test suite handled that automatically. All test rows are prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite now has THREE pytest files, all run via /app/backend/pytest.ini (addopts=-n 2 --dist loadscope): backend_test.py (44 Phase 0/1/2 — note: cross-tenant now 403 not 404), test_phase3_sales_billing.py (37 Phase 3+5), test_bugfixes_iteration4.py (19 iter-4). To run locally use `pytest backend/tests/` which hits the preview URL by default; the iter-4 file targets http://localhost:8001 to allow direct Mongo seeding of password_reset_tokens and session.last_seen_at — the local backend uses the same mongo as preview (test_database on localhost:27017), so direct DB inspection is valid. If the suite returns 429 rate-limit on signup, run `python -c "from pymongo import MongoClient; MongoClient('mongodb://localhost:27017')['test_database'].rate_limits.delete_many({})"` to flush, OR simply wait an hour.
rca of the issue: No new bugs surfaced. The one pre-existing failing assertion (backend_test.py#105) was a stale fixture expectation written before BUG-003 was fixed; updating it to 403 is correct per the review request.
